cohort: The cohort consisted of 15 parents of 14 children (aged under six years) who had been considered for epilepsy surgery within the previous three years.
finding: Unclear communication, lack of information about the assessment steps, and timelines on the epilepsy surgery pathway led parents to feel distressed, uncertain, and 'out of control,' despite initial hope for surgery.
followup_time: up to 3 years post-consideration for surgery (retrospective reporting)
